role: A minimal zlib-backed PNG decoder for the build and the gates: 8-bit non-interlaced RGB or RGBA with every filter type, returning packed RGBA; used to load the oracle's golden frames and the client jar's GUI sheets.
gpu: lines 30, 52, 66, 72: malloc and realloc of the file, IDAT, inflate and pixel buffers (load time only, never in the tick)
notes: No Java counterpart: vanilla loads PNGs through ImageIO (TextureUtil), which this does not port. Only test_render.c and the png2rgba.c tool call it; no file under csrc/engine or csrc/play does.
